Usage: simdreport [flags]

Repeated kernel measurements and TXT/MD/CSV reports. Runs standalone by default.

Options:
  -addition
    	alias for -group addition
  -alpha value
    	float32 scale/affine multiplier (broadcast per call) (default 1.5)
  -backend string
    	measurement backend: compiled or go-test (developer checkout only) (default "compiled")
  -bench string
    	Go benchmark selection expression (default ".")
  -benchtime string
    	duration or iteration count per measurement (default "100ms")
  -beta value
    	float32 affine offset (group defines fusion) (default -0.5)
  -computation
    	alias for -group computation
  -count int
    	measurement repetitions (default 5)
  -dot-input string
    	dot/dotfma fixture: balanced, cancellation, mixed-magnitude, fusion-sensitive (default "balanced")
  -fma-input string
    	fused affine/muladd fixture: balanced, rounding, mixed-magnitude (default "balanced")
  -format string
    	saved report format: txt, md, or csv (terminal stays text) (default "txt")
  -function string
    	deprecated alias: add, compute, or all
  -group string
    	operation group (use -list to see available groups) (default "all")
  -list
    	list implemented kernels and runtime capabilities without benchmarking
  -lower value
    	float32 lower bound (rangefilter exclusive; clamp inclusive) (default -1)
  -output string
    	report directory (default "artifacts")
  -pattern string
    	predicate/clamp fixture: none, all, alternating, clustered, shuffled (default "alternating")
  -seed uint
    	deterministic shuffled predicate seed (default 42)
  -sum-input string
    	sum fixture: balanced, cancellation, mixed-magnitude (default "balanced")
  -threshold value
    	float32 threshold for threshold/selection/predicate
  -upper value
    	float32 upper bound (rangefilter exclusive; clamp inclusive) (default 1)

Examples:
  simdreport -list
  simdreport -group addition -bench '^BenchmarkAddition$/^n=1024$' -count 3 -benchtime 100ms -format md
  simdreport -backend go-test -group computation
